dct_description_sm: Map of the Ganges River from Munger (Munger District), upstream to west of Patna (Patna District), Bihar, India. Villages along the course of the river are marked.
dct_publisher_sm: In Illustrations of the Rivers Hoogley & Ganges from the mouth of the Hoogly to Cawnpore: to which is added tables of routes and distances from Calcutta throughout all the principal inland navigation &ca. &ca. &ca.
